name: Exhaust temperature runaway (heat-wave overload)
description: Unit carries 85 % load. The inlet air temperature then rises by 50 K over 40 s (heat wave / inlet heating) while the load stays fixed, so the exhaust temperature climbs through the 600 degC limiter and the 610 degC alarm. On this isolated, constant-power load the limiter cannot hold the load (cutting fuel lets the speed fall), so protection must take over: alarm first, then a latched over-temperature trip with first-out, fuel closed and breaker opened, before the gas temperature reaches damaging levels.

criteria.text: The over-temperature alarm (610 degC) is raised
True exhaust gas temperature never reaches 700 degC (damage margin)
Fuel flow is zero at the end of the run
Generator breaker is open at the end of the run

negative_tests.text: With the over-temperature trip removed, nothing stops the climb: no trip is raised.
